title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: A behavior talk with a parent
hook: A player keeps disrupting practice. Do you call the parent?
intro: You have talked with the player twice.
statement: Parents usually want to know, and they want to hear it kindly.
q1: Do you bring the parent in early —
q2: or keep working with the player first?
q3: What is going on for this kid outside of practice?
t1: Both can work. But these talks go better
t2: when you share what you see, not a label.
cta: Coaches — when do you involve parents?
ctaLines: After the second time. Only if it is serious. Right away.
ctaPrompt: Share your approach below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player keeps disrupting practice. Do you call the parent?
You have talked with the player twice. The behavior has not changed.
Parents usually want to know, and they want to hear it kindly.
Involve the parent early or work with the player first. There is no single right way.
When do you involve parents? Share your habit in the comments.
